title: Texas FAIR Plan Association - official site
claims: The Texas FAIR Plan Association states that it was established by the Texas Legislature to provide essential property insurance for eligible Texas property owners when no one else will.
The Texas FAIR Plan Association states that applicants must have two declinations from other insurers in order to obtain coverage with TFPA.
The Texas FAIR Plan Association site posts sample policy forms and endorsements.
updateCadence: Re-verify eligibility rules annually and after each legislative session.
